$comment: Pinned contract for goal-blitz: C1 (goal-blitz.mjs), C2 (emit-goal-fire.py), C3 (land-goals.py) and C4 (SKILL.md) build against it; C7 and C8 load it as their shape oracle. Names mirror the roadmap-blitz seam (repoRoot, interactionMode, approver, trailDir). `approver` appears only in `result`, derived by the workflow's ratifierFor, never bound as an arg. Values below are examples of each shape; enumerated alternatives are listed in `_enums`.

seeds.intent: One-line statement of the vision slice to turn into an OKR.

key_results: Measurable key result one, perceptible weekly.
Measurable key result two, perceptible weekly.
roadmap_seeds: Title of a roadmap-seed stub this goal spawns
goal_seeds: Title of a deferred vision-slice goal-seed stub

2026-10-02-example-seed.utterance: the VP-Product Reviewer's verbatim words ratifying the OKR.
